ModMetaData.name: Crew Presets
ModMetaData.author: Luke
ModMetaData.description:
Save named groups of colonists, animals and mechs - "Mining Crew", "Strike Team", "Pack Train" - and apply them with one click in pawn-selection dialogs, instead of hand-picking the same pawns every time.
Works with the vanilla selection dialogs, so it helps every launch and departure: transporters and shuttles (including modded craft), caravans, caravan splitting, and pit-gate entry.
- Save the current selection as a named group from inside any supported dialog. - Apply a group with one click; members that are unavailable (dead, off-map) are skipped with a note. - Manage groups in a simple editor: rename, delete, add or remove members. - Groups are stored in the save file, like bills. - Optional: adds every skill to the "Sort by" dropdown in those dialogs, so you can line colonists up by Cooking, Shooting, Medicine and so on while choosing who goes. Can be turned off in mod settings.
MULTIPLAYER Built with the Multiplayer mod in mind; group changes are synced. Runs fine without Multiplayer installed.
